verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבָרְחֹ֥ו מִפְּנֵי־שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרֽ͏ָה׃
verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «لَا تُهْلِكْ». مُذَهَّبَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ عِنْدَمَا هَرَبَ مِنْ قُدَّامِ شَاوُلَ فِي ٱلْمَغَارَةِ.
verses.en: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David; Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

verses.he: חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל־כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוֹּֽות׃
verses.ar: اِرْحَمْنِي يَا ٱللهُ ٱرْحَمْنِي، لِأَنَّهُ بِكَ ٱحْتَمَتْ نَفْسِي، وَبِظِلِّ جَنَاحَيْكَ أَحْتَمِي إِلَى أَنْ تَعْبُرَ ٱلْمَصَائِبُ.
verses.en: Be gracious unto me, O God, be gracious unto me, for in Thee hath my soul taken refuge; yea, in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.
verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until [these] calamities be overpast.
verses.web: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

verses.he: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְיֹ֑ון לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃
verses.ar: أَصْرُخُ إِلَى ٱللهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ، إِلَى ٱللهِ ٱلْمُحَامِي عَنِّي.
verses.en: I will cry unto God Most high; unto God that accomplisheth it for me.
verses.kjv: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth [all things] for me.
verses.web: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

verses.he: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם ׀ וְֽיֹושִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדֹּ֥ו וַאֲמִתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: يُرْسِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَيُخَلِّصُنِي. عَيَّرَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَهَمَّمُنِي. سِلَاهْ. يُرْسِلُ ٱللهُ رَحْمَتَهُ وَحَقَّهُ.
verses.en: He will send from heaven, and save me, when he that would swallow me up taunteth; Selah; God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.
verses.kjv: He shall send from heaven, and save me [from] the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.web: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

verses.he: נַפְשִׁ֤י ׀ בְּתֹ֥וךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי־אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשֹׁונָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה׃
verses.ar: نَفْسِي بَيْنَ ٱلْأَشْبَالِ. أَضْطَجِعُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِدِينَ بَنِي آدَمَ. أَسْنَانُهُمْ أَسِنَّةٌ وَسِهَامٌ، وَلِسَانُهُمْ سَيْفٌ مَاضٍ.
verses.en: My soul is among lions, I do lie down among them that are aflame; even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.kjv: My soul [is] among lions: [and] I lie [even among] them that are set on fire, [even] the sons of men, whose teeth [are] spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.web: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבֹודֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱرْتَفِعِ ٱللَّهُمَّ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ. لِيَرْتَفِعْ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَجْدُكَ.
verses.en: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
verses.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

verses.he: רֶ֤שֶׁת ׀ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִפְעָמַי֮ כָּפַ֪ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּר֣וּ לְפָנַ֣י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְתֹוכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: هَيَّأُوا شَبَكَةً لِخَطَوَاتِي. ٱنْحَنَتْ نَفْسِي. حَفَرُوا قُدَّامِي حُفْرَةً. سَقَطُوا فِي وَسَطِهَا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: They have prepared a net for my steps, my soul is bowed down; they have digged a pit before me, they are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. Selah
verses.kjv: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen [themselves]. Selah.
verses.web: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

verses.he: נָ֘כֹ֤ון לִבִּ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכֹ֣ון לִבִּ֑י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.ar: ثَابِتٌ قَلْبِي يَا ٱللهُ، ثَابِتٌ قَلْبِي. أُغَنِّي وَأُرَنِّمُ.
verses.en: My heart is stedfast, O God, my heart is stedfast; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.
verses.kjv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.web: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

verses.he: ע֤וּרָה כְבֹודִ֗י ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנֹּ֗ור אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.ar: ٱسْتَيْقِظْ يَا مَجْدِي! ٱسْتَيْقِظِي يَارَبَابُ وَيَا عُودُ! أَنَا أَسْتَيْقِظُ سَحَرًا.
verses.en: Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
verses.kjv: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I [myself] will awake early.
verses.web: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُكَ بَيْنَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ يَارَبُّ. أُرَنِّمُ لَكَ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ رَحْمَتَكَ قَدْ عَظُمَتْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، وَإِلَى ٱلْغَمَامِ حَقُّكَ.
verses.en: For Thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and Thy truth unto the skies.
verses.kjv: For thy mercy [is] great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.web: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

verses.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבֹודֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱرْتَفِعِ ٱللَّهُمَّ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ. لِيَرْتَفِعْ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَجْدُكَ.
verses.en: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: [let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
verses.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
